about: Real microsoft records captured by scripts/probe-bigtech.js on GitHub Actions (runs 5-6, 2026-10-10), descriptions trimmed to their head plus the pay paragraphs. Used by test/bigtech-sources.test.js.
source: GET https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/api/pcsx/search + /api/pcsx/position_details (Eightfold PCSX); each record is the search row merged with its detail data
